collection.description: An elder watching a young apprentice remembers another path they might have taken long ago.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has lived in the village for many years. Today, while watching (apprentice), a young apprentice, at work, (subject.he/she) remembers a decision made long ago. There was another path (subject.he/she) might have taken, another life that might have unfolded. (subject) wonders about it sometimes.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I nearly became a healer," (subject) says. "What stopped you?" asks (friend). "I discovered I loved building things." (subject) looks at the nearby huts. "I still wonder what might have happened." (friend) nods. There is no reason to suppose either life would have been better.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) watches (apprentice) for a while, then returns to (subject.his/her) own work. The memory stays with (subject.him/her) through the afternoon, neither painful nor especially pleasant. Just another part of a long life.
